# ↪️ Pull Request

1. Rename Symbol to CodeSymbol (to not clash with the ES6 Symbol) - open to better suggestions
2. Add JSDoc-like docs to `@parcel/types`

Closes https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/issues/3926

I've added comments to the places where I wasn't quite sure.

To upstream https://parcel2-docs.now.sh/plugin-system/api/
